customer_text.text: Reminders cut our no-shows in the first month. The front desk loves it.
Too pricey for a one-chair salon when I only need the basics.
Setting up all my services took longer than I hoped.
We need group classes with a waitlist before our studio can switch.
Calendar sync dropped two bookings last week.
Support answered within the hour and fixed our deposit settings.
Clients like booking from Instagram at night.
Our physio patients confirm from the text reminder, which saves the front desk a lot of calls.
I wasn't sure how patient details would be stored, so I asked before we started.
The deposit feature means a no-show still pays.
Fine so far, still testing it.
Price is fair for what we get on the Growth plan.
Couldn't work out how to add a second staff member.
Wish it had class packs for my studio.
Moving from paper took a weekend but was worth it.
Reminders went out twice to some clients one morning.
The booking page looks great on phones.
We left because the trial ended before we finished setup.
Cheaper than the receptionist hours it saves.
Hard to move our existing clients over from the old system.
Our clinic manager set it up in an afternoon.
No link to our practice software yet, so the clinic types appointments twice.
Love the waitlist idea. When does class booking arrive for studios?
Not sure it's worth it for a solo trainer.
Chat support was slow on a Saturday.
Deposits stopped our worst no-show offenders.
Does it work for barbers too?
We switched last month and there are fewer gaps in the diary already.
How much is it for 3 staff?
The reminder templates post was really useful.
Can clients pay the full price upfront?
Our studio needs recurring classes.
Great for our clinic's front desk.
